question: A support message calls the change complete. Which is complete, the code fix or the customer rollout, and what remains unfinished?

claims.text: The code fix is the completed item, not the customer rollout: PAY-102 code fix is Done, and PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.

supports.quote: PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.
PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.

claims.text: For payment-retry, the customer rollout remains unfinished: it is available only to the controlled pilot, and general availability (GA) is not approved, with no general release date confirmed.

supports.quote: Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
